name: Twilio SendGrid
summary: Twilio SendGrid is a widely used email sending service for transactional and marketing email, now part of Twilio.

free_plan_covers.note: The old permanent free plan is gone. New accounts get a 60-day trial capped at 100 emails a day, then sending stops.

first_paid_usd_month.note: Essentials plan starts at $19.95/month for up to 50,000 emails.

portability.note: SendGrid supports standard SMTP relay as well as its API, so switching providers mainly means changing SMTP credentials.

sdk_typescript.note: The official @sendgrid/mail npm package is SendGrid's documented Node.js client and includes TypeScript types.

setup.step: Create a SendGrid account and complete Domain Authentication for the domain you will send from.
Create an API key scoped to Mail Send in the dashboard.
Install the SDK with npm install @sendgrid/mail.
Add the key to your environment file.
Import @sendgrid/mail in a server route, set the API key, and call sgMail.send().

builder_notes: Complete Domain Authentication before sending; unauthenticated sending hurts deliverability and can get blocked.
Keep SENDGRID_API_KEY server-side, and scope it to Mail Send only rather than Full Access unless you need other SendGrid features.
The free trial lasts only 60 days; plan to move to a paid plan before it ends or sending stops.
